operators.name: mean_dim0

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: strided (contiguous assumed; supports non-contiguous via temporary contiguous copy if needed)

semantics: Computes torch.mean(x, dim=0) for a 4D tensor with shape [N, C, H, W] where N=512, C=3, H=1024, W=1024.
Reduces over the first dimension (N) for each (c, h, w) position: output[c,h,w] = sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x[n,c,h,w] / N.
The input is on CUDA, float32; output is float32 on the same CUDA device.
The output has shape [C, H, W] = [3, 1024, 1024] and is contiguous with strides [H*W, W, 1].
No broadcasting or additional operations are performed.
Compute the mean of the input tensor x along dimension self.dim (which is 0).
Reduction is over the first axis, producing a tensor of shape [3, 1024, 1024].
The result is on the same device as x (CUDA) and has dtype torch.float32.
